[PERSISTENT EXPERIENCE GUIDANCE]
## Consolidated Experience from Similar Tasks
To transfer an object to a target surface, follow a verified sequence: locate the object, navigate to it, pick it up while confirming grip, locate the target surface, navigate to it, and place the object. Object search may fail if the object is occluded or inside a container, so inspect likely containers/receptacles before concluding it is absent. Never attempt pick_up unless the robot is near the object; navigate or verify proximity first. Never attempt place unless the robot is confirmed to be holding the object and is near the target surface; do not infer holding status from the instruction or a prior action. If a named target instance is unavailable, explore other instances or retry rather than stopping. Success requires successful find, pick_up, target find, and put_down, with verification at each step. For multiple objects, repeat this full sequence for each object until all are transferred.

## Preliminary Thinking
For 'Transfer all ball to the brown table': first locate the brown table and any balls. Search visible surfaces first; if a ball is not directly visible, inspect likely containers, receptacles, or occluded areas. For each ball found: navigate to it, verify proximity, execute pick_up, and verify the gripper is holding it. Then navigate to the brown table, verify proximity to it, execute put_down onto the brown table, and verify the ball is placed. Repeat for every ball. If pick_up fails, re-check proximity and object location; if put_down fails, verify holding status and target proximity; if a search fails, inspect containers or retry. Continue until all balls are confirmed transferred to the brown table.
[/PERSISTENT EXPERIENCE GUIDANCE]
